page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.se1ne.4xlarge is an x86_64 architecture instance belonging to the ecs.se1ne server family. It is powered by a dedicated Intel Xeon 8269CY processor operating at 2.5 GHz, featuring 16 physical cores and 16 vCPUs, resulting in 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, establishing an 8.0 GB per core memory-to-vCPU ratio. It does not include local storage or GPU accelerators, and operates on a KVM hypervisor with a baseline network bandwidth of 3 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance split between single-core and multi-core workloads. Single-core CPU performance is weak, ranking in the bottom 25% for stress-ng and the bottom 10% for Geekbench and single-threaded gzip compression. Conversely, multi-core performance is average, placing in the middle 50% for stress-ng multi-core, Geekbench multi-core, and PassMark CPU tests. Memory bandwidth benchmarks also fall into the average tier, with read-only cached small block speeds reaching 654.2 GB/sec and uncached large block write speeds at 53.85 GB/sec.

The instance offers a high memory density relative to its compute resources, making it qualitatively cost-efficient for memory-bound workloads that do not require high single-threaded CPU speeds. However, the lack of local storage and weak single-core performance are notable tradeoffs. It is best suited for multi-threaded applications, database operations, Redis caching, and medium-scale LLM text generation, where its 128.0 GB memory capacity can be fully utilized.
